name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Program & Account Coordinator
summary: Program and account coordinator with 15+ years supporting distributed networks of partners, clients, and site-level contacts: onboarding and training new contacts, maintaining CRM/database accuracy across concurrent engagements, and identifying and qualifying new partner and program opportunities. Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners at roughly 94% retention, and helped build a new business vertical from proof of concept into a profitable line, including hiring, onboarding, and training new team members. Denver Metro based.

Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating requirements into working configurations and providing hands-on training to non-technical stakeholders.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across operations and delivery.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand engagement scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with each partner's objectives.

Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.
